summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helpers _resolve_path and _check_path_value (stdlib os/json only); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with autofunction in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities entry; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs removed in finally). Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON value is treated as a missing key; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; missing image/label fields are skipped without error. Verification: no line over 120 columns in the three Python files (measured with awk). Not run: tests, black, flake8, per instructions. Nothing committed.
